book.name: Rebelesen
book.title: God nin ha Yon ditongure Rebelesen bol emia

content: Isrel ari handret poti po tausen God maka ingwo ha
Ena ganba uling holo holo i ensel sui sui dire aire mongwo haniwa. Hanigere ensel mole hamen hair a i si mol pangure hon olkimua. Olkire ganba ya, sol wara ya, er han hobi hair sikungwo haniwa.

Hanigere ari mo pa dungwo holi ensel ta mole ungwo haniwa. Hanigere ensel ta i God haang maka ire ure, ganba ya, sol wara ya, isusu ol tenama dire God yulang tongwo ensel sui sui dire mongwo hobi gala dungwo haniwa.

Hanigere ensel ta i yu dimia, “Nan God honagi ol tongwo hobi i ku bolkiminia ganba ya, pil nir ya, hobi olo isusu olkirere han molo. Monanga aki di tenama dire maulung bani kultobane si tere i ku bonaminga sire isusu olanua,” dungwo piriwa.
Pirigere God hau ke tere namba maulung bani engwo hobi kere i ku bongwo Isrel gang wan handret poti po tausen momua dungwo piriwa.
Pirigere tau God yol Yuda namba engwo twel tausen momio, te tau yol Rubin twel tausen momio, te tau yol Gat twel tausen momio,
tau yol Asa twel tausen momio, tau yol Naptalai twel tausen momio, te tau yol Manasa twel tausen momio,
tau yol Simion twel tausen momio, tau yol Liwai twel tausen momio, tau yol Isaka twel tausen momio,
te tau yol Sebiyulan twel tausen momio, tau yol Yosep twel tausen momio, te tau yol Bensamin twel tausen momua, dungwo piriwa.
Ari tabin bir weni God gumang tere ha maing di tongwo ha

Ena yu dungwo pire hanigere, ari miki weni God maulung bani u ku bole momia, kere kun olekiwa. Olekiga hobi gal pege arikri weni pire sugul nima aulung bai are God sipi sipi giring mongwo yali kina i sina olere momua. Mongwo hobi ha howa ta pangwo ure momio, wiyol para weni tau obil sine sine yare ure momio, gaung ta ta hongwo mongwo haniwa.
Hanigere yalhobi molere gala dire yu dimia, “Na arihobi God kene ol na tere na sigare kungure u wai ominga yali sipi sipi giring yali kina obil mo hora kumua.

Dungure ensel para weni God kene ole ami di mongwo bol se ire, kene ongwo hobi ire, hau sui sui dire hobi ire dire, i sina ole mongwo haniwa. Hanigere u ku bongwo hobi para weni i kwi bole God maa e tere tere mongwo haniwa.

Hanigere ha yu ditomia, “Ha weni kara diminua,” dire, maa e tere, demini si tere, nomani si pir tere God ol na tenga wai piminua dire haang awala gale, God nimni monia moli nanga nanua dire ikwi bole gumang tongwo haniwa.
Ari hobiwe, gaung gul ingwo i wai sungwo ha
Ena kene ongwo hobi yal ta yu sirin bol na tongwi, “Gal pege sigiu dungwo hobi makena yal mome?” dimia.

Dungure na “Ni nin gumang hania na hankiwa,” diteiwa. Digere ha yu di na tomia, “Ari gaung gul bir tongure ingwo hobi irai ure momua. Kun sipi sipi giring yal Yisas i gongure tal nigi dongwo ol wangwo pring i olala dire algi ya bolere gaung gal bigi sungure sigare kule u wai pire momua.”
“Mongwo hobi iwe, God kene ongwo bani mole girungwo tangwo God honagi ol te momua. Mongure kene ongwo bol sia ami di mongwo yal i yalhobi aang mol tomua.
Tongure yalhobi nir homena ta wa dukinamua. Te ari de yalhobi mongwo bani ekinamio, te yalhobi mongwo bani miing ta sikinangure mol gwi sire monamua.

God kene onwo sina i sipi sipi giring Yisas Kraist arihobi hobang molere han monamua. Molere aule i nangure nir wai i nenangwo God yulang tenamia ire ya moli nangwo namua. Nangure miling gul sungure hai me mongwo i God nin tol di inangure gun ere monamua.”
